initialization: fresh actor, critic, empirical normalizers, std=.40, Adam and iteration zero; no checkpoint load

task_definition.scope: Issued translation speed > .01 m/s and |requested yaw| <= 1e-6 rad/s
task_definition.anchor: p0, projected body-forward heading psi0, d=Rz(psi0)*command_xy/|command_xy|, n=(-dy,dx)
task_definition.latch: Any numerical command change, including speed-only, or episode reset. Identical messages, pushes, getters, rollouts and PPO updates do not relatch.
task_definition.ordering: Score/capture old command/reference after physics, then resample/reset before next observation.
task_definition.limitation: An unchanged actor cannot select opposite recovery actions from identical observations at opposite hidden offsets.

termination_comparison.caveat: Unbounded Huber costs remain sensitive at large errors. Very large excursions can outweigh the -5 terminal cost over time; falling also loses positive tracking reward and incurs other costs. Neither a magnitudes comparison nor retained-state rescoring predicts reset seeking or learning gradients.

prospective_sampling.kind: Prospective independent segment sampling; no simulator, episode interruption, or historical occupancy

limitations: Offline rescoring of old states, never a new rollout or improvement claim.
Only one chosen parameter set. Long-hold line supervision cannot supply hidden path offset to the actor.
Straight scope uses the issued command after existing sampler deadzones; fixed/replay intentional nonzero yaw is not broadened into a straight segment.
Forward/lateral retained traces calibrate costs; reverse/diagonal are synthetic geometry only.

next_evaluation.nominal_panel: stand 30 s; forward .5, lateral +/- .3, yaw +/- .8: 3 s zero, 30 s command, 8 s zero
priorities: all-axis velocity tracking and responsiveness without reducing travel speed
pose-derived heading/path and full-quaternion drift decomposition
stand displacement/path and full stopping/reversals/residual motion
report_both: recovery information unavailable to unchanged actor
